snippet.title: Sublustrum – Official Trailer (2026) [EN]
snippet.description:
Add to Wishlist on Steam:  http://sub.bwg.cy/Steam_YT

A surreal psychological adventure returns.

The 2008 cult classic, rebuilt in full 3D with new puzzles and an expanded narrative. Developed by Phantomery Interactive in collaboration with Brickworks Games, Sublustrum reimagines its dreamlike world through modern visuals, immersive sound design, and a profound philosophical core.

Step into a universe steeped in surrealism and symbolism — where every sound, shadow, and mechanism holds meaning.
Sublustrum is an introspective journey through memory and the fragile boundary between reality and illusion.

Coming to PC and consoles in 2026.

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sublustrumgame
X: https://x.com/SublustrumGame
Discord: https://discord.gg/VqsuRB6v8E
